JJKMod.BindingVowDef.label: sacrificial oath
JJKMod.BindingVowDef.description: Bind away a quarter of your maximum cursed energy and your bodily defenses (taking 20% more damage), in exchange for +40% cursed technique output and +30% cursed energy regeneration. Permanent and absolute.

JJKMod.BindingVowDef.label: unbreakable body
JJKMod.BindingVowDef.description: Forsake the sharpness of your cursed technique (-35% output, -30% regeneration) to forge your body into a weapon: +55% melee damage, +20% move speed, and 28% less incoming damage. For sorcerers who would rather hit than channel.

JJKMod.BindingVowDef.label: overflow
JJKMod.BindingVowDef.description: Hold a vast reserve at the cost of all restraint: +55% maximum cursed energy and +25% output, but your techniques cost 45% more energy to use. A bottomless tank that drains fast.

JJKMod.BindingVowDef.label: desperation
JJKMod.BindingVowDef.description: Swear that your full power awakens only at death's door. While below 40% health: +70% cursed technique output, +30% move speed, +40% regeneration. While healthy, no effect.

JJKMod.BindingVowDef.label: lone sorcerer
JJKMod.BindingVowDef.description: Swear to fight alone. While no ally stands within 12 tiles: +45% output, +20% move speed, 12% less incoming damage. The moment you are reinforced, the power fades.

JJKMod.BindingVowDef.label: nightstalker
JJKMod.BindingVowDef.description: Swear to hunt only by night. Between dusk and dawn: +40% output, +20% move speed, +25% regeneration. By day, no effect.
